sources.title: lablup/GLM-5.2-NVFP4-DFlash-ko · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A DFlash block-diffusion draft model for speculative decoding, paired with the nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4 target (753B-param MoE, 40B active). Specialized for Korean-query agentic (tool-calling) and coding traffic — trained on captured multi-turn agent trajectories, not benchmark suites.
